prompt:
Create ONE isolated fantasy game inventory item sprite, named "우상의 저주". First reference is ONLY source of monster-specific object design, materials and palette. Second and third references are existing INVENTORY PIXEL ART STYLE examples: match those coarse square pixel clusters and simple stepped dark outlines, broad readable color planes. Do not draw the monster. Idol curse spell icon. Small sinister golden raven eye inset in a compact cluster of dark wine-red raven feathers, tiny jagged antique gold crown ridge. Four small clearly separated crystalline curse motes around it: icy cyan, dark violet, orange fire, acid green. Matching false idol colors. All compact inside square, no writing or background disc.
LAYOUT: 1024x1024 square canvas. One square inventory cell; icon occupies central 85%, balanced silhouette.
STYLE: deliberately low-resolution pixel art, approximately 32 logical square pixels per inventory cell, uniformly enlarged crisp blocks. 3-5 discrete shades per material, dark charcoal-purple outline, pale highlight upper left, no fine microtexture, no smooth gradients, no antialias blur, no photorealism. Preserve large iconic shapes legible at 48px per cell. Transparent RGBA background, alpha zero outside item. No vignette, no glow haze, no shadow under item, no frame, no grid lines, no text, no watermark, no extra unrelated objects. Full intact silhouette with safe margins. Any magic must be solid sharply stepped pixels confined to occupied cells.
